headline: Crude Oil Prices Climb on Middle East Supply Risks
summary: Crude oil prices rose toward a weekly gain as tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and reduced Middle East exports outweighed glut fears.
why: Oil prices are a primary driver of global inflation, corporate transport costs, and energy sector revenues, making supply disruptions critical for all asset classes.
